channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Troy Williams — a ‘street activist’ turned political insider — is stepping down from Equality Utah
item.description: “It just required a different skill set. And I was successful, I think, at pivoting from the street activist to the political insider," Troy Williams said.

item.title: Park Service warns of quicksand at a recreation area in Arizona and Utah
item.description: The National Park Service is warning visitors to beware of areas of quicksand near the shoreline and at drainages throughout the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area.

item.title: Salt Palace gets major cash boost in late-hour bill to move SLC sports district along
item.description: In the last hours of its 2026 session last week, Utah legislators approved at least $50 million to help with reconstruction of the Salt Palace Convention Center.

item.title: The end of the Legislature doesn’t mean the end of Utah political drama. Here’s what’s up next.
item.description: Utah's 2026 legislative session may have come to a close, but politicking in Utah is just starting during a busy midterm election year.

item.title: Utah will sell part of the Great Salt Lake to the feds — a deal lawmakers call a ‘win-win’ for the lake
item.description: After more than a decade of legal fights, Utah has agreed to sell 22,311 acres of the Great Salt Lake’s lakebed to the federal government in exchange for more than $60 million.

item.title: ‘The tragic cost of doing something poorly’: SLC ‘No Kings’ organizers’ negligence led to deadly shooting, suit alleges
item.description: A lawsuit filed by Laura Ah Loo alleges that organizers and volunteers with Salt Lake City's "No Kings" protest last summer were negligent in their duties to put on a safe demonstration.

item.title: Kouri Richins timeline: Here’s what led up to one of Utah’s highest-profile murder trials
item.description: One of Utah’s most-watched murder cases heads to trial this week, drawing attention from national news outlets and true crime podcasters.

item.title: Utah’s newest LDS temple opens to tours. Get a sneak peek inside.
item.description: See inside Utah's newest temple, one that is only the second in the world to have two baptismal fonts.

item.title: An attempt to simplify breaking up Utah’s most liberal county came seconds too late
item.description: The bill would’ve made it easier for cities that want to break away from Salt Lake County to get a measure on the ballot.

item.title: Panthers agree to deal with former Utah Ute Devin Lloyd, the top linebacker available
item.description: Former Utah linebacker Devon Lloyd is leaving the Jacksonville Jaguars for a free-agent deal with the Carolina Panthers.
